decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis draws directly on the firm's maintained tariff and network market-data databases, so the firm can interpret early results and improve the product with knowledge it already holds.
Gas tariff comparison by location is a close extension of the firm's core tariff-data competence and its certified data-capture processes, which makes it easy to assimilate and refine.
A regional electricity tariff calculator applies the firm's precise-calculation and market-data know-how commercially, sits squarely in its knowledge base and has its own page.
The regional energy tariff calculator line builds on the same knowledge, but it is only mentioned on the website and partly overlaps with Product C, so some models may be consolidated.
The regional area definition tool supports the firm's location-based products with grid-area data it already maintains and fits the integrated platform strategy.
Site-specific tariff comparison relies on existing data and calculation expertise, though its low visibility and overlap with Product B create some risk of being folded into other offerings.
